c12: What is the main holiday in Viet Nam mentioned in Unit 12?
Unit 12 covers Our Tet holiday, which is the traditional New Year in Vietnam.
When does Tet usually take place?
Tet usually falls in late January or early February according to the lunar calendar.
What do children often receive from adults during Tet?
Adults give children lucky money in red envelopes to wish them good health and luck.
Choose the word with the different underlined part pronunciation: m_a_ke, pl_a_y, f_a_ce, h_a_ve.
Have has a short sound /æ/, while make, play, and face have the long vowel /eɪ/.
Complete the sentence: "What will you do ________ Tet?"
We use 'during' to talk about an event or holiday that lasts for a period of time, such as during Tet.
What do people usually clean and decorate before Tet?
Families clean and decorate their houses to welcome the new year and bring good luck.
Which flower is traditional for Tet in Southern Viet Nam?
Southern Vietnamese families often decorate their homes with yellow apricot blossoms (hoa mai).
Which flower is traditional for Tet in Northern Viet Nam?
Northern Vietnamese families usually display pink peach blossoms (hoa đào) during Tet.
Find the mistake in the sentence: "They is going to buy a new peach blossom tree."
The subject 'They' is plural, so the verb to be must be 'are', not 'is'.
Rearrange the words to make a meaningful sentence: "do / What / you / will / Tet / during / ?"
What will you do during Tet?
What you will do during Tet?
What do you will do during Tet?
What will do you during Tet?
The correct future simple tense question structure with 'will' is 'What + will + subject + verb...'.
Read and answer: Phong and his parents will visit their grandparents. Where will they go?
Visiting grandparents is a common activity during Tet, meaning they go to their grandparents' house.
What do people often buy to wish for luck and wealth in the New Year?
Kumquat trees with ripe fruits symbolize luck, health, and prosperity for the New Year.
Choose the correct response: "What will you do at Tet?" - "________"
The question is in the future simple tense, so the answer should also use 'will' for future plans.
What is the traditional cake that people eat during Tet?
Banh chung is the traditional sticky rice cake that is a must-have food during Tet.
Read the passage and choose the best answer: Linh and her family are busy before Tet. Linh cleans the floor and her mother makes banh chung. What does Linh do?
The text clearly states that Linh cleans the floor while her mother makes banh chung.
Which activity is NOT usually done during Tet?
Tet is a holiday for relaxing and celebrating, not for taking hard school exams.
Complete the sentence: "My mother ________ some traditional food for Tet tomorrow."
The signal word 'tomorrow' indicates the future simple tense, so we use 'will cook'.
Choose the word that does not belong to the group: Tet, Christmas, Monday, Mid-Autumn festival.
Monday is a day of the week, while the others are all special holidays or festivals.
If you want to wish your teacher a happy new year during Tet, what do you say?
During Tet, people greet each other with 'Happy New Year!'.
Why do people wear new clothes during Tet?
To welcome good luck and happiness
Wearing new clothes is a custom to bring fresh luck, joy, and a new start for the year.
Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently: ch_e_ry, b_e_ll, sw_e_et, m_e_et.
Từ bell phát âm là /e/, các từ còn lại phát âm là /i:/.
Find the word that has a different stress pattern: holiday, blossom, prepare, yellow.
Từ prepare trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai, các từ còn lại trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ nhất.
My father is going to ________ the house and paint the walls before Tet.
Cụm từ quen thuộc là clean the house (dọn dẹp nhà cửa) trước dịp Tết.
Children are always happy to get lucky money ________ red envelopes.
Dùng giới từ in để chỉ hành động đặt tiền lì xì bên trong những phong bao màu đỏ.
What ________ you do tomorrow? - I will go to the flower market.
Câu hỏi về thì tương lai đơn với will để hỏi về dự định trong dịp Tết.
Before Tet, people often go to the ________ to buy peach blossoms and kumquat trees.
Chợ hoa (flower market) là nơi mọi người đến mua hoa đào và cây quất cảnh trước Tết.
Choose the correct sentence to complete the dialogue: “________” - “Yes, I will help my mother clean the floor.”
Will you help your parents prepare for Tet?
What do you do at Tet?
Đáp án bắt đầu bằng Will you... để người trả lời đáp lại bằng Yes, I will.
Find the mistake in the sentence: “She will visiting her grandparents next week.”
Sau động từ khuyết thiếu will phải là động từ nguyên thể, nên sửa visiting thành visit.
My grandparents often stay ________ home and watch fireworks on New Year's Eve.
Cụm từ chỉ địa điểm cố định là at home (ở nhà).
Choose the word that means “a small tree with yellow fruits, popular at Tet in the North.”
Cây quất là kumquat tree, rất phổ biến trong dịp Tết ở miền Bắc.
Complete the sentence: “We ________ visit our uncle in Ha Noi next week.”
Dùng will để diễn tả hành động chắc chắn sẽ làm trong tương lai gần vào dịp Tết.
Rearrange to make a meaningful sentence: “family / My / will / new / clothes / buy / Tet / for / .”
My family will buy new clothes for Tet.
My family buy new clothes for Tet will.
Will my family buy new clothes for Tet.
My family for Tet will buy new clothes.
Cấu trúc câu khẳng định thì tương lai đơn: Subject + will + verb + object.
Read the sentence and choose the best response: “Happy New Year!” - “________”
Happy New Year to you too!
Khi ai đó chúc mừng năm mới, câu đáp lại lịch sự là Happy New Year to you too!
Which of the following activities do children NOT do during Tet?
Vào dịp Tết học sinh được nghỉ học, không phải đến trường cả ngày.
My mother is in the kitchen. She ________ banh chung for Tet now.
Trạng từ now cho biết hành động đang diễn ra, dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn (is making).
Read the passage and answer: “Nam and his parents are decorating their house with red lanterns and a big peach blossom tree.” What are they doing?
Đoạn văn nhắc rõ hành động trang trí nhà cửa với đèn lồng đỏ và cây hoa đào.
Choose the odd one out: firework, banh chung, lucky money, computer.
Computer là thiết bị điện tử, các từ còn lại đều liên quan đến ngày Tết.
Why do people clean and decorate their houses before Tet?
To welcome a lucky and happy new year
Mọi người dọn dẹp nhà cửa để chào đón một năm mới may mắn và hạnh phúc.
If your friend says “Wish you a healthy and happy new year!”, you can reply:
Thank you so much. The same to you!
Lời đáp lại lời chúc tốt đẹp là cảm ơn và chúc lại người đối diện.
What is the English meaning of “hoa mai” in Unit 12?
Trong Unit 12 Tiếng Anh 5, “hoa mai” tiếng Anh là “yellow apricot blossom”, còn “peach blossom” là hoa đào.
